recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: dataframe engines shedding their first skin, faster than before
geothermal turbines waking beneath the crust in twenty-three months flat
clear autumn night over the bay, fourteen degrees and still
agent shortcuts humming from pocket to cloud

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap rising heat pulses from fresh geothermal vents before they cool — each autumn night the crust runs hotter.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: hold/release to channel heat into storage tanks
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: chaining uncooled pulses into one tank before the timer ends feels like banking earth's warmth
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: new vents open faster, cooling accelerates, overlapping pulses demand split attention
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: glowing magma linework on dark basalt, ember particles drifting upward

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Route streaming dataframe columns into the correct lanes as a query engine spins up — Polars-speed sorting under pressure.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left/right to divert each incoming column type
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a flawless sort streak unlocks turbo mode where columns blur into satisfying cascades
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: column types multiply, stream velocity doubles, misroutes clog lanes and slow the whole pipeline
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal phosphor green on matte black, monospace labels snapping into place

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one-thumb paths linking phone shortcuts to cloud agents — each valid route spins up a build before the link decays.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to connect glowing nodes across a circuit board
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: shortest clean path ships instantly; redundant loops waste precious agent slots
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more nodes spawn mid-round, broken links flicker, paths must reroute on the fly
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: cyan blueprint wireflow on deep navy, nodes pulsing like heartbeat LEDs

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Rhythm-tap commits in sync with a rising sun — ship before dawn breaks or the build window closes.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: tap on beat as commit nodes scroll toward a horizon line
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: on-beat taps push the sun over the ridge; one perfect run feels like shipping by sunrise
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tempo climbs, off-beat branches fork the timeline, missed beats add merge conflicts
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor sunrise gradient bleeding from indigo to amber, soft paper texture
